ns2:section.sectionText: [Expanded title: Digital Libraries: Research & Practice] Prerequisites: LIS 501 (or consent of instructor in extraordinary circumstances); Previous or concurrent enrollment in LIS 452 or proof of competency in programming; Students should have access to a personal computer upon which they can experiment on their own with downloaded software tools. Students must be competent in basic computing including the installation and configuration of software packages. [Required core course for the CAS in Digital Libraries concentration]
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Library & Information Science major(s).
